product.name: Car Insurance
product.description: Covers costs arising from road risks for both new and used cars, including direct repairs, theft, total loss, and roadside assistance.

product.name: Health Insurance
product.description: Provides coverage for various health needs including consultations, medications, surgeries, and emergency treatments for individuals from newborns to age 69.

product.name: Home Insurance
product.description: Protects against unexpected costs due to damage to the house structure or contents, covering risks like fire, theft, water damage, and natural disasters.

product.name: Corporate Insurance
product.description: Offers tailored insurance products to protect companies from financial losses due to unexpected events and property damage, including medical insurance for employees.
